data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 asserts that the flags are sustained NOT because the two critics independently found the same counterexample, but because independent NU verdicts (SRC_006 and SRC_008) on a prior artifact established a meta-judgment layer confirming the critics' verdicts as sound. This introduces a meta-layer confirmation mechanism that the problem standard does not invoke. The §11.3 ritual adjudication standard concerns adjudicating the critic's verdicts directly — the problem says 'audit the critic,' not 'audit the auditors of the critic.' By shifting the basis of sustained flags to a peer-review meta-layer rather than the critics' own findings, SRC_001 substitutes an unjustified rationale for the one the standard actually provides, mischaracterizing why the flags are sustained.
